other_conditions: Farmer (including tenant farmer and sharecropper) growing notified crops in notified areas
Must have an insurable interest in the insured crops
Must possess a valid and authenticated land ownership certificate or a valid land tenure agreement
Farmer must be a cultivator or sharecropper on the insured land
Application for insurance must be made within about two weeks of the start of the sowing season
Farmer must not have received compensation for the same crop loss from any other source
benefits_summary: Provides low‑premium crop insurance covering losses from natural disasters, pests, and diseases, with quick claim settlement within two months of harvest.
